items.title: Cisco (CSCO) Stock Lags Record Q1 Earnings As AI Revenue Builds
items.summary: Cisco Systems just posted Q1 FY2027 numbers that read like a victory lap, while the stock is only inching higher. Shares closed at US$97.18, up 2.2% on the day, even as the networking giant delivered record quarterly revenue of US$18.5b and non GAAP earnings per share of US$1.40. That gap between a modest price move and a very strong earnings print is the story. The market is reacting, but not as dramatically as the fundamentals might suggest.
